$comment: Single source of truth for card DATA (identity, deck counts, presentation). Behaviour lives in server/game/cards/*.ts, keyed by the same id. Consumed by the engine, the UI and scripts/gen-card-placeholders.mjs.

cards.name: Exploding Kitten
cards.label: Kaboom
cards.text: You explode unless you play a Defuse.

cards.name: Defuse
cards.label: Save yourself
cards.text: Stops an Exploding Kitten. Put the kitten back anywhere in the deck.

cards.name: Nope
cards.label: Stop that
cards.text: Stop any action except a Defuse or an Exploding Kitten. Can be Noped.

cards.name: Attack 2x
cards.label: Attack
cards.text: End your turn(s) without drawing. The next player takes 2 turns.

cards.name: Targeted Attack 2x
cards.label: Pick a victim
cards.text: End your turn(s) without drawing. A player of your choice takes 2 turns.

cards.name: Personal Attack 3x
cards.label: Take 3 turns
cards.text: End your turn without drawing, then take 3 turns yourself.

cards.name: Skip
cards.label: End your turn
cards.text: End your turn without drawing a card.

cards.name: Reverse
cards.label: Turn it around
cards.text: Reverse the order of play and end your turn without drawing.

cards.name: Shuffle
cards.label: Mix the deck
cards.text: Shuffle the draw pile.

cards.name: Favor
cards.label: Demand a card
cards.text: A player of your choice gives you a card of their choosing.

cards.name: Draw From the Bottom
cards.label: From the bottom
cards.text: End your turn by drawing the bottom card of the draw pile.

cards.name: See the Future 3x
cards.label: Peek at 3
cards.text: Privately view the top 3 cards of the draw pile.

cards.name: See the Future 5x
cards.label: Peek at 5
cards.text: Privately view the top 5 cards of the draw pile.

cards.name: Alter the Future 3x
cards.label: Reorder 3
cards.text: Privately view and rearrange the top 3 cards of the draw pile.

cards.name: Alter the Future 5x
cards.label: Reorder 5
cards.text: Privately view and rearrange the top 5 cards of the draw pile.

cards.name: Garbage Collection
cards.label: Everyone pays up
cards.text: Every player puts 1 card into a pile. Shuffle it and deal the cards back out.

cards.name: Tacocat
cards.label: Annoy
cards.text: No power on its own. Play 2, 3 or 5 matching cards as a combo.
